sentences.en: You will see a forest of masts in the harbor.
sentences.zh: 你会看到海港里桅杆林立。

sentences.en: None of us could arrive at the harbor on time.
sentences.zh: 我们当中没有人能准时到达海港。

sentences.en: Each of these galaxies harbors hundreds of billions of stars.
sentences.zh: 每个星系都包含数百亿颗恒星。
